index_order: original connectome.bin order (neurons.csv.gz row order); the worker's stable group sort is applied at load via sortedToOriginal

populations.name: ORN_FOOD
populations.provenance: classification class=olfactory, sub_class != pheromone (same rule as OLF_ORN_FOOD)

populations.name: GRN_SUGAR
populations.provenance: classification class=gustatory, sub_class=sugar/water (these are in binary group GUS_GRN_WATER; see audit)

populations.name: VPN_LOOM_PROXY
populations.description: Lobula/lobula-plate to PVLP/PLP visual projection neurons (LC/LPLC-like proxy)
populations.provenance: classification super_class=visual_projection and neurons.csv group in LO.PLP,LO.PVLP,LOP.PLP,LOP.PVLP. Cell types are not annotated locally, so this is a connectivity-level proxy for looming-sensitive LC/LPLC populations, not a verified cell-type set. VIS_LC stays empty.

populations.name: LH_NEURON
populations.description: Lateral horn local and centrifugal neurons
populations.provenance: classification class in LHLN/LHCENT (same rule as LH_APP; valence not annotated)

populations.name: DN_ODOR_RANKED
populations.description: Descending neurons most strongly downstream of food ORNs
populations.provenance: top 10% of descending neurons (130) ranked by 3-hop input-normalized excitatory flow from ORN_FOOD (computed on connectome.bin.gz weights)

populations.name: DN_LOOM_RANKED
populations.description: Descending neurons most strongly downstream of the LC/LPLC-like proxy
populations.provenance: top 10% of descending neurons (130) ranked by 3-hop input-normalized excitatory flow from VPN_LOOM_PROXY (computed on connectome.bin.gz weights)

populations.name: DN_TOUCH_RANKED
populations.description: Descending neurons most strongly downstream of bristle neurons
populations.provenance: top 10% of descending neurons (130) ranked by 3-hop input-normalized excitatory flow from MECH_TOUCH (computed on connectome.bin.gz weights)

notes: MB_MBON_APP holds every MBON (class=MBON); valence is not annotated locally, so it is not used as an approach readout.
LH_APP holds all LHLN/LHCENT neurons regardless of valence; LH_AV is empty.
GNG_DESC mixes ascending (AN) and descending neurons; the DN population above separates them.
VIS_ME absorbs visual projection neurons with empty sub_class; VPN_LOOM_PROXY is carved out of it by neuropil group, not by cell type.
No VNC motor neurons exist in FAFB (brain only); leg/wing output is a modeled VNC adapter.

GUS_GRN_SWEET does not contain the sugar receptors: the build rule checks 'water' before defaulting to sweet, so sub_class 'sugar/water' GRNs land in GUS_GRN_WATER. GRN_SUGAR above is the sugar population used for taste.
